temporal_policy: published_at is not observed_at. Do not pass these records to blind_replay.snapshot as historical observations unless contemporaneous capture evidence confirms availability/collection.

cases.subject: Simplified Chinese Pokemon TCG official mainland launch

sources.claim: Announcement of Sep 28 online press launch
Release scheduled Oct 28, Sun & Moon series
Retail / official local events, competitions anticipated
National Championships expanded into four Tier-1 cities

cases.early_hypothesis: Localization plus organized play can seed durable local participation.
cases.rival: Localization might primarily attract collectors or short-lived hype without durable community.
cases.falsifier: Lack of repeat organized play, sustained participation, or sell-through.
cases.outcome_limit: Later company publication indicates championships but not resale ROI, unit sales, or causal attribution.

cases.subject: LEGO 10365 Captain Jack Sparrow Pirate Ship

sources.claim: Set 10365 announced, Sep 12 early access, Sep 15 general sale, €349.99 RRP
Comparison to 2011 set 4184 and quoted asking valuations; not concluded sales
Product available via Insider program and gift with purchase

cases.early_hypothesis: Licensed nostalgia plus a new high-fidelity set can redistribute demand between old and new sealed editions.
cases.rival: New supply can cannibalize older set value or attract builders with little aftermarket follow-through.
cases.falsifier: No demonstrated increase in completed resale transactions or liquidity for any relevant set.
cases.outcome_limit: No historical completed-sales dataset available; no financial return claim.
